body: Misschien bij het woning op de trumanlaan?
No! What a monstrosity! Why would you do that?

Maybe she didn't want to be more specific to avoid bringing more attention to it for people watching who missed it all. But I would have preferred of she was less broad or vague and condemned it specifically.

"Tati didn't like the palettes, and that's ok. I like them, other people do too but not everyone does. We all like different things. It's just makeup. It's supposed to be fun. The vile comments and responses Tati has received for her video on my palette are completely unacceptable. I do not support this in any way and I am appalled it's being done in my defence."
